attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Physical Therapy Examiners (LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 15 contact hours from Certified Activities: courses meeting FSBPT Standards of Continuing Competence; APTA, APTA-SC, other APTA chapters/sections and other state PT boards; university-approved CE; APTA-credentialed residency/fellowship or ABPTS (re)certification / PTA advanced proficiency (meets the whole biennium); graduate academic coursework for PTs, undergraduate acceptable for PTAs (10 contact hours per credit hour); FSBPT/APTA competency tools (5 h if none awarded); AMA-approved PT courses. Up to 15 hours from Approved Activities: other courses (2/5/10 h by length), clinical instruction (1 h per 160 h, max 6, APTA-credentialed CI), in-services incl. CPR (max 3), adjunct teaching (max 10), volunteer PT services (max 7.5), presentations (3 h each, max 6), self-study (max 2), research (10), publications (max 8), mentorship (5).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not subject to the CE requirement for the first biennium renewal period in which initially licensed.
rules.audit_note: Licensee signs a biennial CE report in the manner prescribed by the Board; keep original documentation at least 3 years from the start of the licensure period; random audits.

topics.who: Ethics, professionalism and/or South Carolina jurisprudence, through a Certified Activity (counts toward the 15 Certified hours)

rules.notes: 3.0 CEUs = 30 contact hours (1 CEU = 10 contact hours; 1 contact hour = at least 50 minutes). Licenses are renewed biennially before January 1 (late penalty in January, lapse after January 31). Rule last amended effective May 24, 2024. Board website (llr.sc.gov/pt) was unreachable at check; data from the regulation and statute.
